steps.text: The quality roll for item lsd, item level 28, magic find 200: the tests run in order and the first win ends the roll.

quality.md B: itemratio row 2 (version argument 100); d = ilvl - rec.level = 28 - 20 = 8.
quality.md Test order: unique, set, rare (if the type allows), magic (or magic with no test for an always-magic type), superior, normal; losing the normal test is low.
